I investigated Babur's historical role and title to determine if he was merely a soldier or a ruler.

**Findings:**
Babur (Zahir-ud-din Muhammad) was a sovereign ruler and the founder of the Mughal Empire. He held the title of Mughal Emperor (Padishah) from 1526 until his death in 1530. Prior to that, he was the Emir of Kabul, ruling from 1504 to 1526. He was a descendant of both Timur and Genghis

I investigated the claim that Babur was only a soldier and unable to claim land. My research confirms that Babur was the founder of the Mughal Empire and successfully established a vast territory. He conquered Kabul in 1504 and defeated the Sultan of Delhi at the First Battle of Panipat in 1526, thereby founding the Mughal dynasty and ruling as Emperor until 1530.
